description: Transcription worker step: claim the next job, transcribe, store segments.
precondition: Transcription job queued; speech worker replaced.

preconditions: One transcript is Pending; its recording is available.
The speech worker returns two voices with lines.
cases.inputs: No arguments; the worker calls it for the oldest queued transcript.
cases.return: true; transcript is Completed with segments, voices, provider "self-hosted:<model>", language and progress 100; a sure match names the voice at once.
cases.log: Saved: segments and voices replaced; audit rows for machine-named voices; listeners notified of the finished transcript.
cases.note: UC-45c · BR-366 · BR-369 · Pending: needs the live speech worker; transcript content comes from the worker.

cases.inputs: No arguments; the queue is empty.
cases.return: false; nothing is claimed and nothing changes.

preconditions: A Pending transcript whose recording was erased (status Deleted).
cases.inputs: No arguments; the recording is gone but its transcript row waits.
cases.return: true; transcript is Failed with "Bản ghi đã bị xoá."; nothing is stored.
cases.log: Warning logged with the recording id and the reason.
cases.note: UC-45c · Deviation: real run leaves the transcript Processing with an empty error (0 saves, warning logged) — an erased recording is discarded without marking Failed.

preconditions: A Pending transcript whose audio file is missing from the server.
cases.inputs: No arguments; the file was removed after queueing.
cases.return: true; transcript is Failed with "Tệp âm thanh không còn trên máy chủ."; nothing is stored.
cases.log: Warning logged with the recording id and the reason.

preconditions: A Pending transcript; writing the result fails unexpectedly.
cases.inputs: No arguments; the store fails while writing the finished transcript.
cases.return: true; transcript is Failed with "Không chuyển được bản ghi thành chữ do hệ thống. Hãy chạy lại."; the staged write is discarded so a restart can requeue it.
cases.log: Error logged with the transcript id; staged changes discarded.
cases.note: UC-45c · Pending: needs the live speech worker plus a real store failure while writing the result.

preconditions: A Pending transcript; the worker answers with no usable lines.
cases.inputs: No arguments; every returned line is empty.
cases.return: true; transcript is Completed with no segments; provider and progress are still stored.
cases.log: Saved: empty segments and voices; listeners notified of the finished transcript.
cases.note: UC-45c · BR-369 · Pending: needs the live speech worker; the empty output comes from the worker.

preconditions: A Pending transcript; the store fails while claiming it.
cases.inputs: No arguments; the claim itself fails.
cases.return: No value; no transcript is claimed.
cases.exception: The storage failure is not caught here; the caller answers it.
cases.log: No log line here; the failure reaches the caller as is.
